name: worklog-server-deps
//: npm installs the KPS listener's native addons; Deno then uses this node_modules directly.
//why: Deno's own npm resolver cannot install @kpstreams/server today: its QUIC backend lists @infisical/quic-darwin-arm64 as an optionalDependency and that package 404s on the registry. npm skips a failing optional dependency; Deno treats it as fatal. Run `npm install` once, then `deno task serve`.
//types: Once a package.json exists Deno resolves node: specifiers through node_modules, and node:sqlite's types come from @types/node. Without it `deno check` fails on every file that touches the database.
